'''May 2001 Orland Park tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Civic Center, Orland Park, Illinois on 27 May 2001. It is known from . "Ulaire Fred" .'s tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2382">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-27-orland-park-il-05-27-01d2382/ orland-park-il-05-27-01], DeckTech (. "Ulaire Fred" ., 27 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-27-orland-park-il-05-27-01d2382/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Site:''' Civic Center, Orland Park, Illinois
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
